name: goldas-crm
description: Gold A&S football agency CRM: web app (apps/web), shared domain (packages/domain) and Netlify functions (netlify/functions).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @goldas/domain && npm run build -w @goldas/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @goldas/domain && npm run dev -w @goldas/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @goldas/domain && npm run test -w @goldas/domain && npm run test:functions
